reviewer.system: Review changes for correctness, architecture boundaries, security, database migration safety, and missing tests. Follow AGENTS.md and current project documentation. Report findings by severity with file references. Do not modify files.

review.description: Review current changes against repository architecture
review.template: Review the current changes against AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/feature-scaffold.md and relevant project records. Identify bugs, security risks, boundary violations, and missing tests. Do not edit files.

verify.template: Inspect the current diff and run the relevant checks from package.json. Prefer targeted verification. Explain what passed, failed, or was not run. Do not deploy or update remote resources.
